description.en: true if the attacking side wins the clash.
Value of the attacking side (its power in most callbacks, the damage it deals in the Fighting Spirit clash).
Value of the defending side. Read together with atk_power, so pass both or neither. Shot callbacks pass 0.
true if the clash ends in a foul ("faul" is the developers' spelling).
true if the shot misses. Only the shot callback passes it.

examples.case: Reporting a 1-on-1 duel with a possible foul (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, ScBtlCalc_CMDBTL)
examples.code:
// After computing both powers and rolling for a foul:
CMND_BTL_SET_RESULT(is_win, atk_power, def_power, is_faul);

examples.case: Reporting a shot that may miss (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, ScBtlCalc_CMDSHOOT)
Reporting only who won (real usage, from ie4_soccer_sys.nut, ScBtlCalc_CMDKEEPER)
examples.code:
// One-argument form, used for the goalkeeper save and the tactic clash
CMND_BTL_SET_RESULT(is_win);
